messages.body: The category accounting checks out: 287 classified rows plus 12 decision issues, 299 unique IDs, and the category row counts match their headings. The hazard handoff does not yet reconcile: the full table contains 76 “yes” entries in its Hazard column, while the summary and carried-forward item 2 say 82. This is a document accounting check, not a rerun or reclassification of the compiler findings.
